meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
That's software's guess, Hale. I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag, and it says that number shouldn't be the sole basis for acting against a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My son does not lie, Hale. Are you calling me a liar too, or just him? I'm writing down that you said he cheated, with nothing in your hand but a number.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

"If you keep fighting this." I'm writing that down, exactly as you said it. Procedure 4.4 says a first concern puts nothing in his record, so who decided otherwise, and I'll be in the principal's office when we're done.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale (cc: the principal),

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, nothing on his record, and a visit to the principal; that is not yet the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you ended it before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put anything in front of her that she could check.
What cost ground: You told her that if she kept fighting you would put it on his permanent record, which sounded like punishing a complaint and contradicted what the procedure says about a first concern.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you offered only a score and no times or dates, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After owning that the zero went in before you called her, put one dated thing on the table that she could check herself, instead of opening with the score.
